text: What should you do if a girl is ignoring you? She's not answering your calls, she's not replying to your messages, and you are sitting there waiting, hoping, believing something will happen. Before we talk about what to do, we need to understand why this happens. Because if you don't understand the reason, you probably won't take the solution seriously. So let's break this down. There are two completely different situations when a girl ignores you. The first one is when the story between you basically never started. Maybe you wrote to her on Instagram, or maybe you texted her after meeting somewhere, and she simply never replied. In this situation, the explanation is very simple. You didn't interest her. I'll say it even more directly. She didn't like you. And that's normal, because the only thing everybody likes is a 100 euro bill. Neither you nor I are a 100 euro bill. Some people will like us, and some people won't. That is life. So if at the very beginning, when there was no real conversation, no date, nothing, she ignores you, the story ends right there. Forget about her. Move on. The video is called What to Do, but in this situation, the answer is simple. Do nothing. Don't double or triple text her. Don't try to win her over. Don't start sending flowers. You'll only waste your time and energy. Accept it like an adult and move on. But there's another situation. When something actually started. You were texting, maybe you had a few dates, and then suddenly, she starts disappearing. She stops replying, she stops reacting to your invitation, everything starts going in the wrong direction. In this case, there is a reason. And usually, the reason is one of two things. The first one is over-availability. You meet a girl and immediately make her the center of your life. You text her several times a day. How was your day? What are you doing? What did you eat? I am free anytime if you want to meet. You are always available, always responding instantly, always ready. Instead of being interesting, you become overwhelming. You flood her with attention. You compliment her nonstop. You put her on a pedestal and yourself at her feet. And a normal woman feels suffocated by that. The second problem is the opposite. You move too slowly. You go on a date, you talk, you talk more. First date, nothing happens. Second date, still nothing. No initiative, no flirting, no kissing, no attempt to move things forward. And eventually, she puts you in a friend zone. Some girls keep guys like that around. But many simply lose interest and disappear. Because from her perspective, you don't look like a man with desire or initiative. You look passive, indecisive, like someone who is afraid of his own intentions. So the two main reasons a girl starts ignoring you are simple. You were too available or you were too passive. Now the question is, what should you do when she starts ignoring you? The worst thing you can do is chase her harder. More messages, more attempts, more pressure. That will only push her further away. Instead, you need to mirror the distance. If she pulls away, you pull away too. Stop texting, stop reacting, stop checking her stories. Nothing. Give it time. A week, two weeks, maybe longer. Meanwhile, focus on your own life. Meet other women. Improve your skills. Because the reality is this. It is almost always easier to start something new with another girl and do it correctly from the beginning than to fix a situation where you already messed things up. So don't treat this girl like she's the only option in the world. Put her on a bench. Live your life. If she comes back and starts showing initiative, fine, you can respond. But if she doesn't, who cares? Go build new stories. Meet new women. And next time, don't repeat the same mistakes.
